summary.en: One layer enlarged and one task walked through it: messages hop between the parts round by round, a window shows the change, a round without a tool call stops the loop; optionally back to the overview.
summary.zh: 放大一层，走一遍一个任务：消息逐轮在部件间跳，窗口显示改动，一轮没有工具调用就停下循环；可选回到总图。

fits: The mechanism of an explainer: how a request moves through the parts, round by round.
notFor: Static structure without a flow (use layer-overview); more than four rounds.

intent.en: Make a mechanism concrete by following one real task through it until it stops.
intent.zh: 跟着一个真实任务走到停下，把机制讲具体。

content.en: The overview it zooms from, the detail layout, a typed request (≤ 30 / 14), 1–24 message steps (≤ 22 / 10, kind, times), round labels, a repository window's lines, a stop line, a note.
content.zh: 放大前的总图、细节布局、一行输入（≤ 30 / 14）、1–24 步消息（≤ 22 / 10、类型、时刻）、轮次标签、仓库窗口的几行、停止说明、一条注。

fits.zh: 解说片的机制部分：一个请求如何逐轮穿过各部件。

notFor.zh: 没有流程的静态结构（用 layer-overview）；超过四轮。

en: Text the model writes waits between the model and the frame and types out there; never type it inside a moving chip.
A stop is shown on the loop itself (grey), not with a new symbol.
zh: 模型写的字停在模型和框之间逐字打出；不要在移动中的签里打字。
停止要在循环本身上表现（变灰），不另加符号。

source.path: the source film 11.97–43.4 s; skills/filmsmith/assets/kits/blueprint-zoom/starter/components/zoom.js, loop.js, message.js, line.js, term.js, status.js
